entries.title: Bubbles
entries.description: The cookbook's first synth: two LFOs glissando a sine wave through a comb-filter echo. Eight lines, compiled to a native plugin.

entries.title: Fraction Sequencer
entries.description: A just-intonation pattern written as exact Fractions, stepped at three tempos by three detuned smooth-saw layers into a comb echo.

entries.title: Blip Sweep
entries.description: A detuned pair of band-limited impulse trains whose harmonic count breathes with a slow sine.

entries.title: Sine Cloud
entries.description: Sixteen randomly tuned sines, each pulsing on its own slow LFO -- the whole cloud built by auto-mapping over array-shaped arguments.

entries.title: A Minor Piece
entries.description: A short through-composed piece written with the music.media algebra: a fixed progression, a written melody, and four instruments (bass, Karplus-Strong arpeggios, a bowed resonator pad, a wavetable lead) each in its own register, in an intro, A, B, A', coda form. About 95 seconds.

entries.title: Random Form
entries.description: A dissonant, distorted piece whose notes are all written but whose form is chosen anew on every run: a music.job hierarchy of four-bar sections picks their order, transpositions and climax. Distorted bass and lead, a drum kit defined in the example, plucked strings and bowed clusters. About 75 seconds; this rendering is one reading.
